villa_snapshot: Villa snapshot
Tucked within a serene, gated hillside enclave, this luxe 4-BHK villa is designed for those who find joy in quiet luxury and thoughtful details!

Surrounded by pine-covered slopes and panoramic valley vistas, the villa blends Alpine-inspired architecture with natural stone elements that mirror the landscape. Cobbled pathways, bordered by manicured planters and softly lit by old-world street lamps, set a calming tone—best explored aboard a luxury golf cart.

A private pool sits just off the villa’s entrance, set against a striking mosaic feature wall. Encircled by a wooden deck, the poolside area is complete with sun loungers and a refreshing outdoor shower.

Stepping indoors, the living room is anchored by beige sofas and patterned armchairs, radiating understated elegance. A statement crystal chandelier glimmers overhead, along with stylish decor that includes a black console table, golden sculptures, and delicate arrangements.

Adjacent lies the dining area, centered around an eight-seater table with upholstered high-back chairs. The open kitchen features high-gloss taupe and cream cabinetry, a central island, and premium finishes.

Floor-to-ceiling windows frame expansive vistas from every bedroom, including a cosy attic with a balcony. The master bedroom on the first floor also has a private balcony and an ensuite bathroom with a temperature-controlled toilet seat for elevated comfort.

The home theatre boasts a high-definition projector paired with a large framed projection screen, premium sound system and leather recliners. Ideal for movie marathons, it offers an amazing entertainment experience in a private setting.

For a spa-like experience, relax in the jacuzzi by a large window with stunning hill views. Complementing this setting is a wooden steam room with a bench and dual dials for custom temperature and humidity controls.

Step onto the spacious terrace to enjoy panoramic 360° hill views. Settle into wicker armchairs with striped cushions to unwind under the open sky, surrounded by vibrant flowers that breathe color into the space.
A premium clubhouse for peaceful escapes and memorable evenings, with a serene pool, elegant bar, and more for refined indulgence.

To elevate this experience, a dedicated 5-star hospitality team is always on hand, ready to assist with a warm smile and genuine care, embodying the true essence of "Atithi Devo Bhava." From a butler and chef-on-call to a premium welcome basket and a thoughtful farewell gift, every detail is arranged to make guests feel cared for and pampered!
